Lalitpur Queens is a women's volleyball team from Lalitpur, Bagmati playing in the Everest Women's Volleyball League (EWVL) in Nepal. The team was founded in 2024 and owned by Rupse Sports Management Pvt. Ltd. Lalitpur Queens began their EWVL journey defeating their mighty rivals Kathmandu Spikers in the opening match of the EWVL inaugural edition.
Ayasha Shakya, triple gold medalist in SAG has been appointed as team's goodwill ambassador.
